_doc: C1.2: every warning the v1/v2 compiles emit must match an entry here, or the check FAILS as 'unexplained'. 'attribution' is 'source' (caused by text we authored) or 'tool' (caused by metanorma-iso boilerplate or the toolchain environment). Matching: err.html entries by code (and optional message substring); pdf.err and asciidoctor lines by regex.

STANDOC_68.explanation: Severity-3 information: metanorma-iso announces that its own validation policy file reclassifies 121 rules. Not a defect.

ISO_42.explanation: Our only normative reference is a deliberately fictitious non-ISO document (GTF 100, nofetch) so that no real standard is cited (N8). ISO/IEC DIR 2 allows non-ISO normative references only under conditions; for a fictitious prototype this is accepted and declared.

ISO_66.explanation: Reported on ContentSection boilerplate-copyright-default, i.e. the copyright boilerplate metanorma-iso injects (its website www.iso.org and e-mail address contain lowercase 'iso'). Not authored text (Q6).

ISO_121.explanation: Reported on ContentSection boilerplate-copyright-default: the injected copyright boilerplate contains the digit 8 in the street address 'Ch. de Blandonnet 8'. Not authored text (Q6).

pdf_err.explanation: The ISO PDF stylesheet asks for Cambria, which is proprietary and not provisioned by fontist; mn2pdf substitutes Noto Sans. Cosmetic.
The ISO PDF stylesheet asks for Inter; the provisioned variable Inter font is not usable by FOP, so mn2pdf substitutes Noto Sans (findings-W0 §5). Cosmetic.
